why.title: Why The Veminence?
why.oneText: Every wig, bundle, closure and frontal is made from real human hair that you can style, curl and straighten.
why.twoText: Length, lace size, density, colour and origin are listed on every product, so you know exactly what arrives.
why.threeText: Check out as a guest or with an account, pay by card, BLIK or Przelewy24, and pick an InPost locker, courier or pickup.

textures.title: Shop by texture
textures.text: From sleek straight to defined kinky curls.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Securely through Stripe by card, BLIK, Przelewy24, Apple Pay or Google Pay. You're always charged in Polish złoty (PLN); euro amounts on the site are approximate.
faq.a2: InPost parcel locker, courier to your door, or personal pickup (free). You'll see the delivery fee at checkout before you pay.
faq.q3: Do I need an account to order?
faq.a3: No. You can check out as a guest with just your contact and delivery details. An account is optional and lets you check out faster next time.
faq.q4: What do the length and lace size mean?
faq.a4: Length is measured in inches from the roots to the ends. Lace size is the lace area in inches: a 5x5 closure is 5 by 5 inches, a 13x4 frontal covers 13 inches from ear to ear and 4 inches back.
